newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Binariang to invest 800 mln ringgit for network.
newsitem.headline: Binariang to invest 800 mln ringgit for network.

text.p: Telecommunications firm Binariang Sdn Bhd said on Tuesday its investment in its fixed-line network transmission would be doubled to 800 million ringgit next year.

The national Bernama news agency quoted Binariang chief operating officer Duffy Swan as saying a large portion of the investment would be for installation of a digital switching and transmission system.
"We also expect to install between 9,500 and 10,000 digital lines next year compared with 5,500 digital lines this year," he told reporters after a company function.
Binariang, which owns and operates Malaysia's only communications satellite, also provides digital telecommunications services.
It plans to offer integrated voice, data and video on its fixed-line system next year.
